assumptions: Strict export faithfully represents the source for the fixed input domain; Python side effects and export specializations are not proved.
The triton path runs the source model's Python with only the traced GEMM-shaped calls replaced; every other operation is the PyTorch eager call of the exported graph.
Same device, PyTorch binary, dispatch and floating-point environment.
Eager execution only; no autocast, compiler, dispatch overrides or concurrent state changes.
Rounding mode stays round-to-nearest-even (not introspectable here); gradual underflow was measured on this device when the program was built and is re-checked on every call.
Each explicit primitive is one correctly rounded IEEE 754 operation in its dtype, and separate eager calls are never contracted into a fused operation.
Source artifact has the stated eager ATen semantics; weights are frozen snapshots.

The triton compiler lowers the kernel in kernels.py to one float32 accumulator per output element updated by a fused multiply-add in increasing k, for every tile and every output position (kernel source; FPRev chain, FMA probe and bitwise validation on this device agree).
The bias addition after the kernel is one correctly rounded float32 addition.
Library kernels are preserved as opaque eager calls, not lowered to arithmetic. Identical dispatch must select deterministic kernels for the fixed tensor layouts.
